lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 1 asatapadeeaa ghar 3 ||
lines.translation: Raag Aasaa, First Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Third House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸਿਰਿ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਪਟੀਆ ਮਾਂਗੀ ਪਾਇ ਸੰਧੂਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin sir sohan pateeaa maa(n)gee paai sa(n)dhoor ||
lines.translation: Those heads adorned with braided hair, with their parts painted with vermillion

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਸਿਰ ਕਾਤੀ ਮੁੰਨੀਅਨੑਿ ਗਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਵੈ ਧੂੜਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: se sir kaatee mu(n)neeanhi gal vich aavai dhooR ||
lines.translation: those heads were shaved with scissors, and their throats were choked with dust.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੋਦੀਆ ਹੁਣਿ ਬਹਣਿ ਨ ਮਿਲਨੑਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa a(n)dar hodeeaa hun bahan na milanhi hadoor ||1||
lines.translation: They lived in palatial mansions, but now, they cannot even sit near the palaces. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦੇਸੁ ਬਾਬਾ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aades baabaa aades ||
lines.translation: Hail to You, O Father Lord, Hail to You!

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਵੇਸ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aad purakh teraa a(n)t na paaiaa kar kar dekhahi ves ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O Primal Lord. Your limits are not known; You create, and create, and behold the scenes. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਦਹੁ ਸੀਆ ਵੀਆਹੀਆ ਲਾੜੇ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jadahu seeaa veeaaheeaa laaRe sohan paas ||
lines.translation: When they were married, their husbands looked so handsome beside them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੀਡੋਲੀ ਚੜਿ ਆਈਆ ਦੰਦ ਖੰਡ ਕੀਤੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: heedolee chaR aaeeaa da(n)d kha(n)d keete raas ||
lines.translation: They came in palanquins, decorated with ivory;

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਪਰਹੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਾਰੀਐ ਝਲੇ ਝਿਮਕਨਿ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: uparahu paanee vaareeai jhale jhimakan paas ||2||
lines.translation: water was sprinkled over their heads, and glittering fans were waved above them. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਲਖੁ ਲਹਨੑਿ ਬਹਿਠੀਆ ਲਖੁ ਲਹਨੑਿ ਖੜੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik lakh lahanhi bahitheeaa lakh lahanhi khaReeaa ||
lines.translation: They were given hundreds of thousands of coins when they sat, and hundreds of thousands of coins when they stood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਰੀ ਛੁਹਾਰੇ ਖਾਂਦੀਆ ਮਾਣਨੑਿ ਸੇਜੜੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: garee chhuhaare khaa(n)deeaa maananhi sejaReeaa ||
lines.translation: They ate coconuts and dates, and rested comfortably upon their beds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਗਲਿ ਸਿਲਕਾ ਪਾਈਆ ਤੁਟਨੑਿ ਮੋਤਸਰੀਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tinh gal silakaa paaeeaa tutanhi motasareeaa ||3||
lines.translation: But ropes were put around their necks, and their strings of pearls were broken. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਵੈਰੀ ਹੋਏ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਰਖੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan joban dui vairee hoe jinhee rakhe ra(n)g laai ||
lines.translation: Their wealth and youthful beauty, which gave them so much pleasure, have now become their enemies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਤਾ ਨੋ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਲੈ ਚਲੇ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dootaa no phuramaaiaa lai chale pat gavaai ||
lines.translation: The order was given to the soldiers, who dishonored them, and carried them away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: je tis bhaavai de vadiaaee je bhaavai dei sajaai ||4||
lines.translation: If it is pleasing to God's Will, He bestows greatness; if is pleases His Will, He bestows punishment. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗੋ ਦੇ ਜੇ ਚੇਤੀਐ ਤਾਂ ਕਾਇਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ago de je cheteeai taa(n) kaait milai sajaai ||
lines.translation: If someone focuses on the Lord beforehand, then why should he be punished?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਾਂ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਵਾਈਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਤਮਾਸੈ ਚਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahaa(n) surat gavaaeeaa ra(n)g tamaasai chaai ||
lines.translation: The kings had lost their higher consciousness, reveling in pleasure and sensuality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਰਵਾਣੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਗਈ ਕੁਇਰੁ ਨ ਰੋਟੀ ਖਾਇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: baabaravaanee phir gaee kuir na rotee khaai ||5||
lines.translation: Since Baabar's rule has been proclaimed, even the princes have no food to eat. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਵਖਤ ਖੁਆਈਅਹਿ ਇਕਨੑਾ ਪੂਜਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikanaa vakhat khuaaeeahi ikanhaa poojaa jaai ||
lines.translation: The Muslims have lost their five times of daily prayer, and the Hindus have lost their worship as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਉਕੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਹਿੰਦਵਾਣੀਆ ਕਿਉ ਟਿਕੇ ਕਢਹਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: chauke vin hi(n)davaaneeaa kiu tike kadhahi naai ||
lines.translation: Without their sacred squares, how shall the Hindu women bathe and apply the frontal marks to their foreheads?

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਹੁਣਿ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: raam na kabahoo chetio hun kahan na milai khudaai ||6||
lines.translation: They never remembered their Lord as Raam, and now they cannot even chant Khudaa-i||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਇਕਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪੁਛਹਿ ਸੁਖ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik ghar aavahi aapanai ik mil mil puchhahi sukh ||
lines.translation: Some have returned to their homes, and meeting their relatives, they ask about their safety.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਏਹੋ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਬਹਿ ਬਹਿ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਦੁਖ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikanhaa eho likhiaa bahi bahi rovahi dukh ||
lines.translation: For some, it is pre-ordained that they shall sit and cry out in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਨੁਖ ॥੭॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so theeai naanak kiaa maanukh ||7||11||
lines.translation: Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass. O Nanak, what is the fate of mankind? ||7||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਖੇਲ ਤਬੇਲਾ ਘੋੜੇ ਕਹਾ ਭੇਰੀ ਸਹਨਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahaa s khel tabelaa ghoRe kahaa bheree sahanaaee ||
lines.translation: Where are the games, the stables, the horses? Where are the drums and the bugles?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਤੇਗਬੰਦ ਗਾਡੇਰੜਿ ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਲਾਲ ਕਵਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahaa s tegaba(n)d gaaderaR kahaa s laal kavaaee ||
lines.translation: Where are the sword-belts and chariots? Where are those scarlet uniforms?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਆਰਸੀਆ ਮੁਹ ਬੰਕੇ ਐਥੈ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahaa s aaraseeaa muh ba(n)ke aithai disahi naahee ||1||
lines.translation: Where are the rings and the beautiful faces? They are no longer to be seen here. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu jag teraa too gosaaee ||
lines.translation: This world is Yours; You are the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਘੜੀ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਜਰੁ ਵੰਡਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਭਾਂਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek ghaRee mahi thaap uthaape jar va(n)d devai bhaa(n)ee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: In an instant, You establish and disestablish. You distribute wealth as it pleases You. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਾਂ ਸੁ ਘਰ ਦਰ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਹਲਾ ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਬੰਕ ਸਰਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahaa(n) s ghar dar ma(n)dap mahalaa kahaa s ba(n)k saraaee ||
lines.translation: Where are the houses, the gates, the hotels and palaces? Where are those beautiful way-stations?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਾਂ ਸੁ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਵੇਖਿ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahaa(n) s sej sukhaalee kaaman jis vekh need na paaee ||
lines.translation: Where are those beautiful women, reclining on their beds, whose beauty would not allow one to sleep?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਪਾਨ ਤੰਬੋਲੀ ਹਰਮਾ ਹੋਈਆ ਛਾਈ ਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kahaa s paan ta(n)bolee haramaa hoeeaa chhaaee maaee ||2||
lines.translation: Where are those betel leaves, their sellers, and the haremees? They have vanished like shadows. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜਰ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਘਣੀ ਵਿਗੁਤੀ ਇਨਿ ਜਰ ਘਣੀ ਖੁਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: is jar kaaran ghanee vigutee in jar ghanee khuaaee ||
lines.translation: For the sake of this wealth, so many were ruined; because of this wealth, so many have been disgraced.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪਾ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੁਇਆ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: paapaa baajhahu hovai naahee muiaa saath na jaaee ||
lines.translation: It was not gathered without sin, and it does not go along with the dead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਖੁਸਿ ਲਏ ਚੰਗਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jis no aap khuaae karataa khus lae cha(n)giaaee ||3||
lines.translation: Those, whom the Creator Lord would destroy - first He strips them of virtue. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟੀ ਹੂ ਪੀਰ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਏ ਜਾ ਮੀਰੁ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kotee hoo peer varaj rahaae jaa meer suniaa dhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Millions of religious leaders failed to halt the invader, when they heard of the Emperor's invasion.
